text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] runtime-eu-west: queue depth > 95th percentile for 5m, 5xx rate up 8x. Paging oncall: @ivy
ivy: I'm on it. grabbing logs and tailing runtime. @mike.r can you confirm model pool and top tenants?
mike.r: seeing embed-7q pool saturation. KV-cache eviction spikes and lots of inflight for tenant=acme (~65% of inflight ops). Customers hitting timeouts/502s. Sample repro request: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embed -d '{"input":"long..."}'`
priya: can we soft-shed the big offender tenant? propose: per-tenant rate cap acme -> 0.5 rps and enable soft-shedding on medium priority lane. I'll push rate limit now.
priya: running: `./infractl set-tenant-rate --tenant acme --region eu-west --rps 0.5`
ops-bot: Command accepted: set-tenant-rate acme eu-west 0.5 — propagation ~30s
mike.r: also recommend tightening max_inflight for medium lane (120 -> 80) to avoid head-of-line blocking, and lower request timeout (45s -> 25s) for medium lane to fail fast.
kevin: applying flow-control changes now: `kubectl -n runtime patch configmap flow-control --patch '{"data": {"medium_max_inflight":"80","medium_timeout_s":"25"}}'`
ops-bot: Applied: medium_max_inflight=80, medium_timeout_s=25s — change rolled to runtime-eu-west
ivy: quick check 30s post-change: queue depth down ~40%. 5xx rate falling. acme still has some 429/timeouts but much improved (5xx -> 3%).
alice-cs: ACME Inc reports an uptick in 429s after throttle. Do we want to run a customer notice?
product-oncall: yes, send a short proactive note: "We detected high request volume affecting embeddings; we've applied a temporary throttle and disabled streaming to stabilize; we'll update in 1h." @alice-cs can you send?
mike.r: to reduce runtime pressure further I'd like to disable streaming and stop prefix-heavy batch merges for acme temporarily — lower connection churn.
ivy: go ahead, @mike.r toggle tenant streaming=false and keep cache settings unchanged for now.
mike.r: `infractl tenant-config set acme streaming=false` — running
ops-bot: Tenant config updated: acme streaming=false
ivy: Monitoring 5m window: CPU/GPU utilization down ~30%, queue depth normalized, end-to-end tail latency improved. We'll keep throttles in place for 1 hour, then relax to 1rps if stable.
priya: opened follow-up issue INC-5023: investigate KV cache eviction frequency, consider increasing cache shards or TTL, and check model quantization path for thrashing.
ivy: Handoff to night oncall @kevin at 00:30 UTC — please watch runtime-eu-west and tenant acme. Escalate if 5xx > 1% sustained for 15m.
kevin: ack. I have the runbook and contact list.
ops-bot: INCIDENT: mitigations applied and initial stability observed. Incident ticket created: INC-2026.
ivy: summary for postmortem: root cause likely tenant traffic spike driving KV-cache churn and model pool saturation; mitigations: per-tenant rate cap, reduced medium lane inflight, lowered timeouts, disabled streaming for tenant, follow-ups for cache tuning. Keeping ticket open until 2h stable window. :thumbsup:
